request:
{"op":"define","source":"word customer.renewal-balance : Customer Subscription -> Float
    effects none
    doc "Returns the existing discounted balance, with a further 5% reduction only for premium customers on renewable annual subscriptions."
    let subscription
    let customer
    $customer customer.discounted-balance
    let balance
    $customer customer.premium?
    if
        $subscription subscription.term
        "annual"
        equals
        if
            $subscription subscription.renewable
            if
                $balance
                0.95
                float.multiply
            else
                $balance
            end
        else
            $balance
        end
    else
        $balance
    end
end

test customer.renewal-balance/premium-annual-renewable
    "premium" 100.0 customer.new
    "annual" true subscription.new
    customer.renewal-balance
    => 85.5
end
